0022600177.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-6) visit the New York Knicks for their eighth game of the season, having lost five straight and gone 1-4 on the road, and they sit 13th in the East and five games back in the Central. The Knicks (3-4) are coming off a win, have a 2-2 home record, and sit eighth in the East and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic, though Josh Hart is out with an ankle injury. The Bulls trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 133-127 in Chicago on October 28, and Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring injury while Jalen Smith is day-to-day with a finger injury and a game-time decision.
